subject: Current WVB publisher verifier versus frozen native publisher products
claim: The current publisher source builds through the current split compiler and its validation-only Windows executable accepts the migrated Canonical-Package-Text test WVB. The frozen front-door and newer frozen candidate publishers reject that same WVB at semantic validation. The validation-only executable does not publish a destination. This distinguishes working current semantic validation from unfinished transactional publisher construction.

source.value: Publisher project/source at 22d02e4c; current split compiler products from the related reconstruction evidence, acquired through the uncommitted Project 4 launcher integration. The migrated test WVB comes from the preserved package working tree, not a committed package release.

runs.target: Current publisher WVB and validation-only hosted executable
runs.command: Build current Projects/Tools/Windvale-Wvb-Publisher.wvproj to Project4-Current-Publisher.wvb with a 180000ms command deadline, then package profile 7 as Project4-Current-Publisher-Validation.exe with a separate 180000ms command deadline; both completed.

runs.tool: Current validation-only publisher, frozen front-door publisher, frozen candidate publisher
runs.command: Invoke each product with the same candidate and a distinct absent destination. Current validation-only product returned 0 and created no destination. Both frozen publishers returned 1 with publication status=Rejected phase=semantic and created no destination.

limitations: This is a diagnostic result for one valid input on Windows, not publisher qualification, malformed-input coverage, full package conformance, or a new Debian result.

Generic profile-7 packaging exercises the publisher Main's candidate validation only. It does not attach the specialized native publication startup, adapter, and transaction state; it must not replace a real publisher.

The existing specialized construction path pins old WVB/WVO/image identities and exact Main/begin/apply offsets. Its current-source test reconstructs and compares WVB/WVOP/WVLI, then exits without constructing a current transactional executable.
No publication pin or installed artifact was changed. The Project 4 launcher changes remain uncommitted and their five-case test remains incomplete after an eight-minute preparation timeout.
The broad changed-file plan, full hosted publisher owner, and cold cross-host qualification were not run. Prior cache evidence was reused only through existing exact-input cache checks.
